copy.headline: You may enjoy exploring possibilities while finding routines less appealing.
copy.body: Higher openness and lower conscientiousness describe interests and habits reported in this assessment. You may enjoy considering alternatives while reporting less inclination toward schedules or repeated follow-through. Actual understanding, task skills, and the reasons for unfinished work require separate examples.
copy.strength_sentence: If considering alternatives has helped in a recent task, identify what you did and where it was useful; these scores alone do not establish that skill.
copy.risk_sentence: The price is: the more complex the idea, the more likely it is that it will remain between conception, revision and starting over due to the lack of a closing mechanism.
copy.context_boundary: This pattern is clearest in open-ended, long-horizon work that requires self-directed closure; it may matter less in short tasks with fixed steps.
copy.action_hook: Your priority action is not to reduce ideas, but to set next steps, cutoff points, and completion criteria for your most valuable ideas.
